hero.desc: Full-stack developer based in Lima, Peru. I build web and mobile apps — and occasionally solder things that probably shouldn't work but do.

about.title: A bit about me.
about.body: I'm a full-stack development student at Cibertec, Lima — working across web, mobile, and everything in between. I gravitate toward clean architecture, good APIs, and interfaces that actually make sense to use. Outside the screen, I build furniture, solder circuits, and make chainmail.

items.desc: Lead developer on multiple team projects spanning web, mobile, and API development. Consistent focus on clean architecture and real-world deployment.
Set up Microsoft 365 email hosting for a client — DNS configuration, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC records, and mailbox provisioning via Namecheap.
Full-stack web development, mobile (iOS/Android), web services, concurrent programming, and software testing.
